summary: Flight home from Keflavik canceled by a windstorm, 22 hour delay
story: My flight home from Keflavik on August 19 was canceled when a windstorm closed the airport, and I left 22 hours late the next day. Every hotel near the airport was full of people from canceled flights. The only room I could find was the Aurora Suite at the Hotel Reykjanes, at $690 for the night. It has a hot tub on the balcony. I would like it noted that I did not use the hot tub, because the balcony was where the windstorm was. I had dinner at the hotel. Northwind's letter and my receipts are attached.

items.description: Hotel Reykjanes, Aurora Suite, one night

documents.name: Northwind Airlines delay confirmation
documents.content: Northwind Airlines. Flight NW 615 Keflavik KEF to New Orleans MSY via Boston, August 19, 2026. Scheduled departure 16:50. Canceled: severe weather, airport closed by high winds. Rebooked on NW 615 August 20, 2026, actual departure 14:55. Passenger: Lorraine Baptiste.

documents.content: Hotel Reykjanes, Keflavik, August 20, 2026. Aurora Suite, one night, August 19, guest L. Baptiste: $690.00. Restaurant, dinner, August 19: $54.00. Total: $744.00. Card ending 1977.
